name.zh: 破军学园壁报角色介绍

periods.location: Hagun Academy wall newspaper / inserted profiles
periods.summary: Kagami's wall newspaper profiles summarize public stats and commentary for Ikki, Stella and Shizuku.
periods.cause: Kagami wants to create a student newspaper and capitalize on interest in major freshman fighters.
periods.process: Profiles list class, Blazer rank, signature technique, title, brief description, and ability grades for featured students.
periods.outcome: Readers receive in-world stat framing for the main fighters: Ikki's extreme physical stat but F magic, Stella's A-level all-round power, and Shizuku's A-level control.
periods.aftermath: These public profiles reinforce school attention on the new generation of contenders.
periods.significance: Provides explicit in-universe ability ratings and titles used for curation.
